commits.message: CLAUDE.md: performance is a count of work, never a clock; load tests are banned

Declared chrome and cursor state, re-sent on tmux reattach (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.sfp) (#605)

* Declared chrome and cursor state (rich-control-codes-xh4n.6ch.sfp): App.chrome sends the title over the terminal's title stack, and iTerm2's tab color (OSC 6), session status (OSC 21337) and badge, once per change and given back on every exit; a focused TextInput colors the terminal's cursor (OSC 12/112) with its accent; focus reports (CSI ? 1004) and resizes re-send what reached the terminal only through a passthrough, which a tmux reattach forgets

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Review fixes (6ch.sfp, high pass): the title stack is its own part so a pop follows only a push that reached the terminal; commitTerminalState takes a Pick, so undefined reaches only parts that hold it; badge backslashes escaped against iTerm2 interpolation; the cursor color is what the drawn cell shows (a reversed cell's foreground, none for default); App.chrome reset on stop; tmux focus-events off by default stated; wireHex and notSent each defined once

* Review fixes (6ch.sfp, medium pass): a resend keeps the refusal of a later change; a status is the same as another when it writes the same bytes; a part decides one send or none; the commit order is stated where it lives; the not-a-terminal record is built by notSent

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

The colour-depth and pause playground tests play at one frame a second, so they no longer paint hundreds of unread gallery frames (rich-palette-xovz.u60) (#598)

* The colour-depth and pause playground tests play at one frame a second, so they no longer paint hundreds of unread gallery frames (rich-palette-xovz.u60)

* The no-color checks require a painted frame, so an empty window cannot pass them (rich-palette-xovz.u60)

* One writtenOver check: what a window wrote must hold a gallery frame, and a depth rebuild must keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)

* One frame per colour depth; pause is pinned at sixty frames a second over a tenth of a second; the rate and frame checks say what they read (rich-palette-xovz.u60)

* Resume is pinned over half a second; the last depth rebuild is checked to keep 1 fps (rich-palette-xovz.u60)
The unclosed-links linearity test starts at 4,000 links, so a saturated suite stays well clear of the hang limit (rich-unfiled-791c.m154)
